title: 第19章 小试融合第20章 赢金樽楼训狗
content_zh:
小试是武馆每月一回的考较。
到了这日，师娘会亲临坐镇。
弟子们捉对比试，实打实地过招，若能夺得第一，便能得到一份馆里备下的厚赏。
路沉好奇“也不知这小试头名，究竟能得什么彩头，金兄可晓得？”
“当然晓得，彩头是梅花丹，馆里秘药之一。”
“有何功效？”
金铭搓了搓下巴“具体是什么名堂我也不甚清楚，只听说药力比每日喝的汤药霸道得多。这些年馆里能突破外劲的，基本都是每月小试拔得头筹的那几位。”
“原来如此。”
路沉眼睛微微一亮。
金铭看出他的心思，笑着摇头“劝你别惦记那梅花丹，馆里藏龙卧虎，可没那么好拿。”
“我心里有数。”路沉点头。
下午。
金铭又来约路沉吃酒。
路沉推说有事，婉言回绝了。
他倒不算说谎，今日正是月末，是该收平安钱的日子。
这世道，老百姓既要向朝廷纳粮缴税，也少不得给地头上的帮会交一份平安钱。
羊圈街的平安钱，路沉不收死数，看生意定钱
做力气活营生的，月钱一百五十文。
卖吃食的摊贩，月钱二百四十文
有门脸开店的，月钱三百文。

交了这钱，路沉便保他铺面安宁，无人敢生事。
当然，这也就防防那些泼皮无赖。
若是真得罪了有来头的人物，路沉也兜不住。
街上做生意的，倒也愿意掏这个钱，不然遇上吃白食的，撂下碗就走，小偷拿了东西，揣怀里往人堆里一钻，你找谁说理去？
打他一顿？回头他天天来搅和你生意。
送官？县衙里谁管你这点鸡毛蒜皮。
比起韩老五，路沉已经很厚道了。
那位若来，每家每户的平安钱少说翻上三倍，逢年过节、初一十五还要多添两成孝敬，那才叫敲骨吸髓。
即便路沉如此仁义，每月到了收钱的日子，街上总有人交不齐数目。
不是搓着手赔笑，说这月买卖淡、手头紧，下回一定补上，便是掏遍全身只摸出几枚铜板，讪讪道“就这些了…您先收着。”
路沉往往也不较真，略点点头，手一挥，人就不为难了。
content_en:
The quiz is a monthly test in the martial arts school.
On this day, the master's wife will come and take charge.
The disciples compete against each other in a real-life competition. If they can win the first place, they will get a generous reward prepared by the hall.
Lu Chen was curious, "I don't know what kind of prizes will come from being ranked first in this small test. Does Brother Jin know?"
"Of course I know. The lucky number is Plum Blossom Pill, one of the secret medicines in the store."
"What effect does it have?"
Jin Ming rubbed his chin, "I don't know exactly what it is. I only heard that the potency of the medicine is much more powerful than the decoction you drink every day. Those who can break through the external power in the gym these years are basically the ones who come out on top in the monthly small tests."
"That's it."
Lu Chen's eyes lit up slightly.
Jin Ming saw his thoughts and shook his head with a smile, "I advise you not to worry about the Plum Blossom Pill. There are hidden dragons and crouching tigers in the museum, and it's not that easy to get."
"I know it well." Lu Chen nodded.
afternoon.
Jin Ming came to meet Lu Chen for a drink again.
Lu Chen suggested that he had something to do and declined politely.
He wasn't lying. Today was the end of the month and it was the day to collect peace money.
In this world, the common people not only have to pay grain and taxes to the court, but they also have to pay peace money to the local gangs.
The safe money on Yangquan Street, if the road is heavy, the number of deaths will not be collected, the money will be determined according to the business
Those who make a living by doing strength training earn 150 yuan a month.
A street vendor selling food, earning 240 Wen per month
A decent shop owner earns 300 cash per month.
After paying the money, Lu Chen would keep his shop safe and no one would dare to cause trouble.
Of course, this also prevents those scoundrels.
If he really offended a well-connected person, Lu Chen wouldn't be able to deal with it.
Those who do business on the street are willing to pay this amount. Otherwise, if they meet a freeloader, they will put down their bowls and walk away. If the thief takes the thing and burrows into the crowd, who are you going to talk to?
Beat him up? Then he comes to disturb your business every day.
Send official? Who in the county government cares about your trivial matters?
Compared to Han Laowu, Lu Chen is already very kind.
If that person comes, each household's peace money will at least be tripled, and an additional 20% of filial piety will be added during festivals and the first and fifteenth day of the lunar month.
Even though Lu Chen is so benevolent and righteous, there are always people on the street who fail to pay the full amount every month when it is time to collect money.
Either he rubs his hands to apologize and says that business is slow this month and money is tight, and he will make up for it next time, or he digs all over his body and only finds a few copper coins, saying humbly, "That's all... you keep it first."
Lu Chen often didn't take things seriously. He would nod his head or wave his hand, so people wouldn't be in trouble.
